scope: read-only source audit; deletion candidates are conditional, not executed replacements or visual/performance PASS

items.action: Use gpui_kit::application/init/open_window; remove direct Base initialization and manual Root construction.
items.conditions: Keep capture/profiler setup and one Root; verify overlay initialization and native/Web entry points.

items.action: Reuse Symbols MaterialSymbols/WithMaterialSymbols/IconNamed and Component Icon; remove duplicated SVG wrapper and Lucide table after mappings land.
items.conditions: Unify Kit source/revision. Cover component internal icons, data-backed icons, dimensions, rotation and variation axes; resolver must not regenerate SVG per draw.

items.action: Use one Component Theme projection and rem-size authority; remove competing runtime theme/scale writes.
items.conditions: Retain full M3 roles, reference interpolation and token data; update theme only when it changes, preserving overlays and multi-window behavior.

items.action: Move the Material browser consumer into a separate workspace package in the Symbols repository.
items.conditions: Keep Symbols core acyclic when Material depends on it; preserve Kit integration and consumer capabilities.

items.action: Reuse Component navigation/search/layout and Story patterns; do not depend on an assumed external catalog registry.
items.conditions: Story has hardcoded registration; retain Material state matrices, capture and performance evidence.

items.action: Keep narrow busy/focus/transition fixes while aligning the Git Base dependency.
items.conditions: Same 0.8.1 version is not equivalence; upstream lacks the patched busy, focusable/disabled focus and reversal/reduced-motion behavior.

items.action: Keep Material tokens and curves; reuse the playback engine instead of creating a new scheduler.
items.conditions: Base Spring and Material Spring have different parameterization/retargeting; verify conversion before removing math. Re-audit against primary reference.

items.action: Keep full Material roles and schemes; reuse generic utilities only after numerical equivalence.
items.conditions: HSL, Oklab and RGBA blends are not interchangeable; Component semantic tokens do not retain all M3 roles.

items.action: Keep required detailed text, original-hitbox extension, passive touch and DPR fixes until the selected runtime supplies equivalent behavior.
items.conditions: Kit still depends on unpatched gpui-pre 0.3.10. Inspect actual runtime source and repeat regressions; do not remove entire vendor trees based on package names.

items.action: Keep complete CPU scope and raw first-frame evidence; upstream FPS HUD is supplementary.
items.conditions: Upstream sampler excludes warmup/backlog and uses draw timing; it cannot prove whole-gallery <=2ms including first frame.

items.action: Keep dynamic browser reduced-motion integration.
items.conditions: No equivalent Story API was established in this audit; verify live preference changes before removal.

items.action: Replace manual input slot composition with Component Input prefix/suffix/appearance(false), retaining Material container styling.
items.conditions: Use the same InputState; validate internal padding, prefix/suffix spacing, focus and accessibility. Existing code does not duplicate IME/editing.

items.action: Use Tag::custom for ordinary metadata/status labels, not count Badge.
items.conditions: Tag adds hover opacity(0.9) without an exposed hover override; precise static labels need a hook or a small renderer.

items.action: Use GroupBox/Settings for ordinary titled groups and field organization; remove redundant factories after call sites migrate.
items.conditions: Use content_style for body styling. Preserve connected corners, pair/details and Material-only surfaces; extra GroupBox nodes are not automatically faster.

items.action: Use Component Alert for appropriate urgent/danger messages.
items.conditions: Alert uses Role::Alert; do not silently upgrade informational Role::Status. Preserve action wrapping and reference appearance.

items.action: Reuse upstream queue, timeout, pause and dismissal when those are added; keep Material Snackbar as presentation.
items.conditions: Current Snackbar is caller-positioned surface, not a duplicated notification engine. Notification.content does not replace its shell or animation.

items.action: Reuse Component where its hooks meet the contract; retain Material renderers over Base parts for uncovered shape/ripple/track/thumb motion.
items.conditions: Component outer Styled does not expose every internal part. These current controls already reuse Base behavior; do not add extra wrappers merely to change imports.

items.action: Use Component Sheet for modal sheets; keep nonmodal standard sheet layout until a proper capability exists.
items.conditions: overlay(false) does not disable the Base focus trap; replacing a nonmodal side sheet would change keyboard access to main content.

items.action: Consolidate duplicated drag, double-click and window-control execution into Component TitleBar.
items.conditions: First provide caller labels/control slots, configurable height/traffic lights/leading geometry, overlay order and explicit close-veto adaptation; current private controls are not equivalent.

items.action: Reuse Settings organization and real RadioGroup semantics for radio choices; keep only Material connected layout.
items.conditions: ListItem selected/on_click is not a substitute for complete button/radio keyboard and accessibility behavior.

review_scope: Three independent source audits cover components; facade/theme/icons/gallery; runtime patches/motion/performance. No runtime migration or deletion was executed in this audit.
